[[Railroad]] |Season = {{Season|Any}} |Edibility = -300 |Sell Price = {{Price|1500}} |dsvprice = 1500 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] item that can be found by digging up [[Stardew:Artifact Spots|Artifact Spots]] in the following locations: * [[Adventurer's Summit]]: 5% chance * [[Stardew:Backwoods|Backwoods]]: 5% chance * [[Stardew:The Desert|The Desert]]: 5% chance * [[Stardew:The Farm|The Farm]]: 1% chance * [[Stardew:The Mines|The Mines]]: 2% chance * [[Railroad]]: 5% chance It can also be purchased from the Red Junimo in the [[Junimo Woods]] or [[Joja Emporium]], when players take the Joja Route, for {{Price|60000}}. A single {{PAGENAME}} is required to be donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]] to complete the collection. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Gunther, Krobus |like=Magnus }} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|gray}}When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} results in a gray color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
